title: Two-Ball Rebound Reaction
description: A coach tosses two balls off the backboard in quick succession, forcing a rebounder to secure the first and immediately react to the second.

content.objective: Secure a rebound and immediately react to a second ball without pausing to reset.
content.setup: A coach stands with two balls, ready to toss them off the backboard one after another.
instructions: The coach tosses the first ball off the backboard for the rebounder to secure.
Immediately after the first rebound, the coach tosses the second ball.
The rebounder reacts and secures the second ball without a pause to reset.
coachingPoints: Stay on the balls of the feet, ready to react instantly.
Keep the hands up and active between tosses.
Secure each rebound fully before thinking about the next one.
commonMistakes: Relaxing after the first rebound instead of staying ready.
Reaching for the second ball instead of jumping to meet it.
Reaching for the ball with one hand instead of securing it with two.
content.safety: Coach tosses the ball with control, not a hard throw that risks injury.
